source.normalization: Explicit ae/oe ligature expansion; NFKD and combining-mark removal; ASCII words; QU->CW, remainingQ->C; greedyGP within words; no ngrams across paragraphs.
source.training_data: No Liber Primus plaintext or ciphertext, and no Self-Reliance text is used.

limitations: Beam search is heuristic; all finite paths are not enumerated. Negative result does not exclude this cipher family.
All cyclic cuts are tried; top16percut generated under trigram are reranked by a4gram model. Null replicates repeat this selection.
External-only training, but LP controls were previously inspected; not fresh blind validation.
Seed lengths4..12 only; no arbitrary F subset or cross-page key.
